title: The time interpretation of expected utility theory
abstract: arXiv:1801.03680v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ergodicity economics is a new branch of economic theory that notes the conceptual difference between time averages and expectation values, which coincide only for ergodic observables. It postulates that individual agents maximise the time average growth rate of wealth, known widely as growth optimality. This contrasts with the dominant behavioural model in economics, expected utility theory, in which agents maximise expectation values of changes in psychologically transformed wealth. Historically, growth optimality was explored for additive and multiplicative gambles. Here we apply it to a general class of wealth dynamics, extending the range of economic situations where it may be used. Moreover, we show a correspondence between growth optimality and expected utility theory, in which the ergodicity transformation in the former is identified as the utility function in the latter. translated_title: 期望效用理论的时间解释
translated_abstract: 遍历性经济学是经济理论的一个新分支，它指出了时间平均值与期望值之间的概念差异，二者仅在遍历可观测量时才相等。该理论假设个体代理人最大化财富的时间平均增长率，这一原则被广泛称为增长最优性。这与经济学中占主导地位的行为模型——期望效用理论——形成对比，在期望效用理论中，代理人最大化的是经过心理转换后的财富变化的期望值。历史上，增长最优性主要是在加法博弈和乘法博弈的情境下被研究的。本文将其应用于一类一般性的财富动态过程，扩展了其可适用的经济情境范围。此外，我们展示了增长最优性与期望效用理论之间的对应关系，其中前者的遍历性变换可被识别为后者的效用函数。这一对应关系为选择效用函数提供了理论基础。
tldr: 本文将增长最优性从加法和乘法博弈推广到一般性的财富动态过程，并证明了增长最优性与期望效用理论之间存在对应关系——遍历性变换即等价于效用函数，从而为效用函数的选择提供了理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper extends growth optimality from additive and multiplicative gambles to a general class of wealth dynamics and establishes a correspondence between growth optimality and expected utility theory, identifying the ergodicity transformation as the utility function, thereby providing a theoretical basis for the choice of utility functions.
